requirements.text: Render only the viewport plus overscan while bounding retained rows and bytes.
Pin result snapshot and sort/filter generation; global operations execute on complete server data.
Cancel stale requests and use cursor or credit backpressure with reconnect semantics.

problem.scope: Full-stack authored design for 100k+ query rows. Compare snapshot cursor pages with credit-limited streaming to a persisted result spool. Rendering virtualization and total retained-byte bounds are independent; no browser performance numbers are asserted.
